RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE - LARGE LOAD




                   SOAH ORDER NO. 12
  ADMITTING EVIDENCE; REMANDING CASE TO THE COMMISSION;
           AND DISMISSING FROM SOAH’S DOCKET


      On September 15, 2026, Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO)
filed on behalf of the parties: (1) a unanimous stipulation and settlement agreement
(Stipulation) that resolves all contested issues in this case, and (2) a joint motion to
admit evidence and remand this proceeding to the Public Utility Commission of
Texas (Commission).


      As shown by the joint motion and Stipulation, there are no remaining
contested issues that require a hearing. Accordingly, the joint motion is
 GRANTED, and the following items are ADMITTED into evidence as requested
by the parties:1

                                  SWEPCO Exhibits
    1       Application for Authority to Amend Tariffs for Retail Service
    2       Direct Testimony of Melissa A. Gage (adopted by Lynn Ferry-Nelson)
   2A       HSPM Direct Testimony and Exhibit of Melissa A. Gage (adopted by
            Lynn Ferry-Nelson)
    3       Rebuttal Testimony of Lynn Ferry-Nelson
   3A       Workpapers to the Rebuttal Testimony of Lynn Ferry-Nelson
   3B       HSPM Workpapers to the Rebuttal Testimony of Lynn Ferry-Nelson
    4       Rebuttal Testimony of Alex E. Vaughan
   4A       Workpapers to the Rebuttal Testimony of Alex E. Vaughan

                                    Staff Exhibits
    1       Direct Testimony of Adrian Narvaez

                                     CARD Exhibits
    1       Direct Testimony & Exhibits of Anthony M. Georgis
    2       Workpapers to the Direct Testimony & Exhibits of Anthony M. Georgis
    3       Affidavit of Alfred R. Herrera Related to Rate Case Expenses Incurred by
            CARD

                                     OPUC Exhibits
    1       Gov. Abbott Governor of Texas Letter to Thomas Gleeson, Chairman,
            Public Utility Commission of Texas, and Pablo Vegas, President and CEO,
            Electric Reliability Council of Texas, June 10, 2026

                                   TIEC Exhibits
    1       Direct Testimony and Exhibits of Shawn McGlothlin (Includes Errata)
   1A       Workpapers to the Direct Testimony and Exhibits of Shawn McGlothlin
            (Inc. Native File)
    2       SWEPCO Response to TIEC 1-9
    3       SWEPCO Response to TIEC 3-4


1 See Joint Motion to Admit Evidence (Aug. 13, 2026).

       This case is REMANDED to the Commission and DISMISSED from
SOAH’s docket. As soon as practicable, SWEPCO SHALL email a Word version of
the Proposed Order attached to the Stipulation as Attachment B to the Commission
at cadmorders@puc.texas.gov.



Signed October 5, 2026



                                         _____________________________
                                         Cassandra Quinn,
                                         Administrative Law Judge
